  [ Our Businesses ][52]
  * [Pharmaceutical, Medical Supplies & Products Distribution Services][53]
    
    We distribute pharmaceuticals and medical supplies to healthcare settings across North America,
    from pharmacies and hospitals to doctors’ offices and clinics.
    * [Pharmaceutical Distribution Services][54]
    * [Medical Supply Distribution][55]
  * [Pharmacy Services][56]
    
    We help to ensure the financial wellbeing of pharmacies and health systems and support a stable
    work environment for their employees.
  * [Oncology & Multispecialty Solutions][57]
    
    We provide research, insights, technologies and other support to help address challenges in
    cancer and specialty care.
  * [Biopharma Capabilities][58]
    
    We provide a suite of solutions designed to address access, affordability and adherence
    challenges by bridging the gaps between biopharma companies, pharmacies, providers, and payers
    to help patients get on and stay on their medications.
  * [Prescription Benefit Solutions][59]
    
    We offer solutions that enable employers, payers, health-plan brokers and government agencies to
    provide lower-cost options for prescription medications and therapies.
  * [Consumer Products & Services][60]
    
    We help to ensure the financial wellbeing of pharmacies and health systems and support a stable
    work environment for their employees.

# Advancing Health Outcomes for All®

[ Discover McKesson ][125]

## Making Healthcare Happen

McKesson Corporation is a U.S.-based company with approximately 43,000 employees worldwide and
facilities across the U.S. and Canada. We serve as the logistical and operational backbone of the
U.S. healthcare system, helping ensure patients can access the therapies and care they need when and
where they need them.

Business Solutions
 

## Our Areas of Focus

Our services and technology ensure medicines reach every care setting, bring cancer and specialty
care close to home, and help patients break through access and affordability barriers.

We’re reimagining what’s possible by accelerating clinical trials, helping patients start and stay
on therapy, and building a stronger, smarter supply chain for the future.

[ Learn More ][126]

setting.]

[A person in a yellow shirt and gray cardigan holds a smartphone and a pill bottle, with a child in
the background.]

### [ Prescription Benefit Solutions ][131]

[Person sitting on the floor in a living room, wrapping a bandage around their elbow. A yellow
ottoman and a glass of water are in the background.]

### [ Consumer Products & Services ][132]

[Worker pulls pallet jack quickly through a warehouse aisle, shelves lined with boxes, motion blur
emphasizing fast movement.]
Strengthening Healthcare
 

## Powering Care Locally

For nearly two centuries, McKesson has strengthened the systems that move care forward by supporting
providers, enabling access to medicines and therapies, and removing barriers across the patient
journey.

# Advancing Health Outcomes for All®

[ Discover McKesson ][125]

## Making Healthcare Happen

McKesson Corporation is a U.S.-based company with approximately 43,000 employees worldwide and
facilities across the U.S. and Canada. We serve as the logistical and operational backbone of the
U.S. healthcare system, helping ensure patients can access the therapies and care they need when and
where they need them.

Business Solutions
 

## Our Areas of Focus

Our services and technology ensure medicines reach every care setting, bring cancer and specialty
care close to home, and help patients break through access and affordability barriers.

We’re reimagining what’s possible by accelerating clinical trials, helping patients start and stay
on therapy, and building a stronger, smarter supply chain for the future.

[ Learn More ][126]

### [ Consumer Products & Services ][132]

[Worker pulls pallet jack quickly through a warehouse aisle, shelves lined with boxes, motion blur

Strengthening Healthcare
 

## Powering Care Locally

For nearly two centuries, McKesson has strengthened the systems that move care forward by supporting
providers, enabling access to medicines and therapies, and removing barriers across the patient
journey.

# Your Trusted Source for Security, AV and Smart Living Solutions

ADI is a leading distributor and solution provider of security, AV, and smart living products
serving over 100,000 customers worldwide. We offer access to a broad portfolio of products,
including top-tier distributed brands and our own exclusive brands.

With more than three decades of industry experience, we're committed to building long-lasting
customer relationships - making us a preferred partner for professionals across the industry.

# Our Mission

### We aim to provide products, services and software that help keep our communities safe, secure,
### comfortable and connected.

## Here's How We Do It

### Access to Exclusive Brands

We take pride in our exclusive, in-house manufactured products and software solutions, delivering
smart solutions that combine quality and innovation. From home automation to commercial-grade
infrastructure, we craft technologies that focus on what customers value most – delivering a
reliable and exceptional experience

[Access to Exclusive Brands]
[Support and Services]

### Support and Services

We offer a wide range of support and services to provide expert guidance at every step - from design
and configuration to ongoing support. With OvrC Remote Management, customers can easily manage,
configure, and troubleshoot devices across the network. OvrC is available on a range of exclusive
brand products and integrates with many leading distributed brands. Additional offerings include
systems design, technical support, rewards programs, training, project registration, and more.

### Robust Product Selection

With more than 500,000 products from over 1,000 trusted brands, ADI offers a carefully curated
selection of solutions to meet the needs for any application. We make purchasing easy - customers
can shop in-store or online and choose from multiple delivery options or in-store pickup.

Advin Manufacturing Facility

equipment manufacturing. With dedicated floors for R&D, assembly, testing, and packaging, it ensures
streamlined, high-quality production. Cleanroom environments and global standard compliance
highlight Advin’s commitment to innovation and healthcare excellence.
Advin Corporate House

global operations. Designed for collaboration and innovation, it embodies a modern, professional
environment. The workspace reflects Advin’s vision of leadership and excellence in the healthcare
industry.

Advin Storage Facility

workflows to handle high-volume medical products with speed, accuracy, and efficiency. Automated
handling, digital inventory control, and clearly defined storage zones ensure product safety,
traceability, and consistent quality.

This advanced storage and dispatch facility reflects our commitment to precision, scalability, and

## Solutions

[APT Medical extension catheter]

### Overcoming Tortuosity

Expressman™ Guiding Extension Catheter and CONQUEROR™ Lollipop NC PTCA Balloon Catheter with
Spherical Tip help overcome the tortuosity and bring out the best clinical outcome.

[Big Thumb]

### Big Thumb

As one of the most reliable and professional medical device suppliers, APT Medical provides
Braidin™, a thin-wall, braided stainless steel mesh introducer sheath, the outer diameter is 1F
lower than conventional introducer sheath. It allows the novel distal trans-radial access (dTRA).

[APT Medial catheter products: 6.5F introducer sheath and guiding catheter set]

### 6.5F Set Gives You More

6.5F Braidin™ Introducer Sheath & 6.5F March™ Guiding Catheter provides a solution to approach via
radial artery with larger guiding catheter inner lumen.

### Integrated Access Solution: From Puncture to Dilatation

For the challenging treatment of Lower Extremity Artery Disease (LEAD), APT Medical has developed an
empowering access solution, providing streamlined workflow and improved outcomes.

### SinusFlex™, More Flexible

SinusFlex™ mapping catheter specially designed for the CS placement through femoral vein.

Braidin™, a thin-wall, braided stainless steel mesh introducer sheath, the outer diameter is 1F
lower than conventional introducer sheath. It allows the novel distal trans-radial access (dTRA).

radial artery with larger guiding catheter inner lumen.

For the challenging treatment of Lower Extremity Artery Disease (LEAD), APT Medical has developed an
empowering access solution, providing streamlined workflow and improved outcomes.

# See what your competitors
# will do next.

While others chase press releases and earnings calls, we capture real intelligence from the data
trails companies leave behind unknowingly — whether competitors, acquisition targets, potential
partners, or emerging disruptors.

Book a Demo

[From digital exhaust to predictions]

## Trusted by teams at

[Intuit][S2A][Eleventh Hour Group][Abridge]
The Problem

## Why traditional intelligence falls short
* Curated narrativePress releases, earnings calls, official announcements — that's the story
  companies want you to see. By the time something is announced, it's too late to respond
  strategically. You're reacting, not planning.
* Commoditized sourcesTraditional market intelligence pulls from the same obvious sources everyone
  else uses. If you're reading it, so are your competitors.
* Data without contextTraditional tools bombard you with notifications — a job posting here, a doc
  update there. You spend hours trying to figure out what matters. You have alerts, not answers.

How it works

## From digital exhaust to predictions

Each step compresses the input. Thousands of raw signals collapse into a handful of patterns, then
into a single forecast you can act on.
* Digital exhaust
  LinkedIn activity
  Job descriptions
  API documentation
  Web & copy changes
  Reddit threads
  + 19 more source types
  CaptureWe monitor the unintentional data trails companies leave behind — job descriptions
  revealing technical debt, API documentation exposing new features, employee posts leaking project
  updates and more. Intelligence they never meant to share.
  Signals

  12 AE roles, 3 metros
  Product
  New API surface
  Endpoints + docs added
  SynthesizeA single job post or pricing page tweak is noise. Hundreds, woven together, become
  patterns. We connect signals across sources — hiring spikes, doc changes, ad shifts, partnership
  chatter — to surface the combinations that actually mean something.

What is Henry?

Henry is a telehealth service that makes it easy and affordable to get the medical care you need. We
help people manage weight loss, perimenopause and testosterone hormone therapies, and erectile
dysfunction, as well as other conditions. It’s easy to get started—just answer a few questions about
your health and lifestyle goals, and we’ll connect you with an expert provider. If medically
approved, you’ll get your prescribed medication by mail within a week. There’s no insurance
required. Just a simple monthly bill with your provider visits, medication and supplies, and ongoing
care included.

How does Henry work?

Henry makes it easy to get the personalized care you need in just a few steps. Answer a few
questions about your health and goals. A licensed healthcare provider will review your information
and recommend treatment if necessary. If prescribed, you’ll get your medication by mail within a few
days. There’s no insurance stress or surprise bills. Just one monthly payment that includes your
provider visit, medication and supplies, and ongoing care.

Who can use Henry?

Henry is open to all adults! To use Henry, you must: Be 18 years or older. Have a demonstrated
medical need for treatment. Live or have an address in one of the states we support.

How do I see a provider?

Click any “Get Started” button and answer a few questions about your health and lifestyle goals.
You’ll then be able to schedule a provider visit face-to-face with a video call, or depending on
your home state, choose an independent provider review without a video call. You and your provider
will be able to exchange messages through our secure patient portal.

Does Henry require a long-term contract?

No long-term contracts! Henry offers convenient monthly plans, as well as longer term plans for
certain treatments. You can easily cancel any time.

How soon will I receive my medication?

Most people receive their medication within 8-10 business days after they speak to their provider.
Just a heads up, people in California may experience longer fulfillment times because of additional
compound testing requirements.

What if I need to cancel?

You can cancel at any time in your account page of the patient portal, by contacting our support
team at ask@henrymeds.com, or by calling 909-787-2342. If you’re on a multi-month plan, you may be
required to pay out the rest of your balance unless you’re unable to continue for medical-related
reasons as determined by a healthcare provider.

What is compounded medication?

Compounded medication is prescription medicine from a licensed provider that’s custom-made by a
licensed pharmacist. Instead of a one-size-fits-all drug from big manufacturers, the pharmacist will
mix or adjust ingredients in compounded medication to tailor to your specific needs. Because these
medications are customized, they’re not FDA-approved in the same way as commercial drugs, but they
do use FDA-approved ingredients.

Do I need insurance?

No, you don’t need insurance! Henry makes it easy to get the care you need without having to deal
with insurance claims. Your provider visits, medication and supplies, shipping, and ongoing care are
all included in your plan price—without any hidden or surprise fees.

*If medically eligible

## Frequently Asked Questions

][25]

What is Henry?

Henry is a telehealth service that makes it easy and affordable to get the medical care you need. We
help people manage weight loss, perimenopause and testosterone hormone therapies, and erectile
dysfunction, as well as other conditions. It’s easy to get started—just answer a few questions about
your health and lifestyle goals, and we’ll connect you with an expert provider. If medically
approved, you’ll get your prescribed medication by mail within a week. There’s no insurance
required. Just a simple monthly bill with your provider visits, medication and supplies, and ongoing
care included.

How does Henry work?

Henry makes it easy to get the personalized care you need in just a few steps. Answer a few
questions about your health and goals. A licensed healthcare provider will review your information
and recommend treatment if necessary. If prescribed, you’ll get your medication by mail within a few
days. There’s no insurance stress or surprise bills. Just one monthly payment that includes your
provider visit, medication and supplies, and ongoing care.

Who can use Henry?

Henry is open to all adults! To use Henry, you must: Be 18 years or older. Have a demonstrated
medical need for treatment. Live or have an address in one of the states we support.

How do I see a provider?

Click any “Get Started” button and answer a few questions about your health and lifestyle goals.
You’ll then be able to schedule a provider visit face-to-face with a video call, or depending on
your home state, choose an independent provider review without a video call. You and your provider
will be able to exchange messages through our secure patient portal.

Does Henry require a long-term contract?

No long-term contracts! Henry offers convenient monthly plans, as well as longer term plans for
certain treatments. You can easily cancel any time.

How soon will I receive my medication?

Most people receive their medication within 8-10 business days after they speak to their provider.
Just a heads up, people in California may experience longer fulfillment times because of additional
compound testing requirements.

What if I need to cancel?

You can cancel at any time in your account page of the patient portal, by contacting our support
team at ask@henrymeds.com, or by calling 909-787-2342. If you’re on a multi-month plan, you may be
required to pay out the rest of your balance unless you’re unable to continue for medical-related
reasons as determined by a healthcare provider.

What is compounded medication?

Compounded medication is prescription medicine from a licensed provider that’s custom-made by a
licensed pharmacist. Instead of a one-size-fits-all drug from big manufacturers, the pharmacist will
mix or adjust ingredients in compounded medication to tailor to your specific needs. Because these
medications are customized, they’re not FDA-approved in the same way as commercial drugs, but they
do use FDA-approved ingredients.

Do I need insurance?

No, you don’t need insurance! Henry makes it easy to get the care you need without having to deal
with insurance claims. Your provider visits, medication and supplies, shipping, and ongoing care are
all included in your plan price—without any hidden or surprise fees.

*If medically eligible

## Experience perfection in the quality of well-designed products

### About Us

Our company, Krishna Enterprises, deals in medical equipment. Therefore, we have a profound
understanding of the responsibilities we handle. Any mishandling can impact the lives of a lot of
people. Hence, we are propelled by an unflinching pursuit of perfection; we label every product with
batch codes and unique identities and keep an ardent eye on the quality of these products. All these
items go through several quality-assurance tests before they leave the confines of our facility.
Such an endless strive for perfection has been the pivotal force behind our success in the market.
It has also made us one of the leading suppliers, traders, wholesalers, and exporters of Aspiration
Catheter, Central Venous Catheters, Double Lumen CVC Catheter, Medtronic Sprinter Balloon Dilatation
Catheter, Cordis Hospital Introducer Sheath, Abbott Plastic Inflation Device, and more.

# Enjoy the Best Views in Austin from Mount Bonnell

#### From Mount Bonnell, the high point Austin TX, you have awesome views on Austin, the Colorado
#### River and the Texas Hill Country

[ Visit Mount Bonnell ][23]
 

### What to Do at Mount Bonnell

At the peak you will find Covert Park, an Austin view point with 360-degree views that include the
city skyline and Lake Austin. This free Austin Mount Bonnell experience attracts locals and tourists
from around the world and offers a variety of activities. There are plenty of nearby Lake Austin
hotels and luxury hotels in Austin to provide you with a memorable stay.

[ 10 Reasons to Visit Austin Mt Bonnell ][24]

## About Mount Bonnell

Bonnell Mountain is a great landmark and one of the most visited sites and tourist attractions in
Austin. The limestone height stands at 775 ft above sea level and is considered to be the highest
point within Austin City Limits. It has been a popular sightseeing destination since the mid-19th
century and continues to attract tourists and locals for mountain biking, hiking, and more on the
Mount Bonnel hiking trail. In fact, it’s a favorite for mountain bikers and a Mount Bonell hike is
on the bucket list of many tourists. Mount Bonnell also known as Covert Park belongs, next to other
parks such as Mueller Lake Park and Zilker Park, to the best parks in Austin.

Visit Mt. Bonnell Austin TX and Covert Park at Mount Bonnell trails and enjoy the beauty of the
Austin skyline. If you want to learn more, you can also buy one of many topographic maps with
elevation data and Austin TX Mount Bonnell directions. So, when tourists arrive and ask: Are there
mountains in Austin, Texas? You can tell them to get ready for an exciting walk on the Mt Bonell
stairs to the top. While you’re visiting Bonnell Austin, don’t forget to take in [Circuit of
Americas][25] Austin TX, the country’s premier destination for phenomenal motorsports and live
entertainment. If you’re a diehard sports fan, check out 104.9 The Horn Austin, it’s a local Austin
radio station with station broadcasts in sports format and is the flagship station of the Texas
Longhorns. If My Bonnell has given you an appetite for heights take a trip out to Texas Hill Country
to see the rural countryside of Central Texas with its rugged hills and native vegetation.

If you’re looking for accommodation, you’ll be spoilt for choice, from family hotels to five star
hotels in Austin. [Hotel Saint Cecilia][26] in Austin and [The Loren at Lady Bird Lake][27] both
offer upscale accommodations where you can recover after sightseeing in two of the best Austin
luxury hotels.

[ About Mount Bonnell ][28]

## Mount Bonnell Gallery

Check out our gallery page with beautiful photos of Mount Bonn that other visitors have shared. Why
not share your own favorite pic featuring Mount Bonnell for the chance to win a cool t-shirt?

# Enjoy the Best Views in Austin from Mount Bonnell

#### From Mount Bonnell, the high point Austin TX, you have awesome views on Austin, the Colorado
#### River and the Texas Hill Country

[ Visit Mount Bonnell ][23]
 

### What to Do at Mount Bonnell

At the peak you will find Covert Park, an Austin view point with 360-degree views that include the
city skyline and Lake Austin. This free Austin Mount Bonnell experience attracts locals and tourists
from around the world and offers a variety of activities. There are plenty of nearby Lake Austin
hotels and luxury hotels in Austin to provide you with a memorable stay.

[ 10 Reasons to Visit Austin Mt Bonnell ][24]

## About Mount Bonnell

Bonnell Mountain is a great landmark and one of the most visited sites and tourist attractions in
Austin. The limestone height stands at 775 ft above sea level and is considered to be the highest
point within Austin City Limits. It has been a popular sightseeing destination since the mid-19th
century and continues to attract tourists and locals for mountain biking, hiking, and more on the
Mount Bonnel hiking trail. In fact, it’s a favorite for mountain bikers and a Mount Bonell hike is
on the bucket list of many tourists. Mount Bonnell also known as Covert Park belongs, next to other
parks such as Mueller Lake Park and Zilker Park, to the best parks in Austin.

Visit Mt. Bonnell Austin TX and Covert Park at Mount Bonnell trails and enjoy the beauty of the
Austin skyline. If you want to learn more, you can also buy one of many topographic maps with
elevation data and Austin TX Mount Bonnell directions. So, when tourists arrive and ask: Are there
mountains in Austin, Texas? You can tell them to get ready for an exciting walk on the Mt Bonell
stairs to the top. While you’re visiting Bonnell Austin, don’t forget to take in [Circuit of
Americas][25] Austin TX, the country’s premier destination for phenomenal motorsports and live
entertainment. If you’re a diehard sports fan, check out 104.9 The Horn Austin, it’s a local Austin
radio station with station broadcasts in sports format and is the flagship station of the Texas
Longhorns. If My Bonnell has given you an appetite for heights take a trip out to Texas Hill Country
to see the rural countryside of Central Texas with its rugged hills and native vegetation.

If you’re looking for accommodation, you’ll be spoilt for choice, from family hotels to five star
hotels in Austin. [Hotel Saint Cecilia][26] in Austin and [The Loren at Lady Bird Lake][27] both
offer upscale accommodations where you can recover after sightseeing in two of the best Austin
luxury hotels.

# We help you create the next generation of minimally invasive solutions

[ Talk to an expert ][22]

### Saint Gobain Catheter Systems becomes NexInLife.
### MS techniques and Transluminal are pleased to announce that they are joining Arev.

[Logo NexInLife with baseline]

## Innovative and reliable solutions for medical devices

At NexInLife, we support customers worldwide in **developing and manufacturing cutting-edge
solutions** for their catheters and medical devices.

As a **one-stop shop**, we operate across the entire value chain – **from complex custom extrusion
to minimally invasive delivery systems**. We help our customers **from conception and engineering to
prototyping and mass production**.

With over 25 years of experience under **ISO-13485**, we deliver high performance solutions for
cardiovascular, neurology, gastroenterology and many other applications.

Thanks to our **in-house compounding and extrusion capabilities for complex custom medical tubing**,
we ensure precision, quality and efficiency at every step of your project.

[ Discover our expertise ][23]

## Our Services

Our collaboration goes beyond the products.

### Fast prototyping

• Sample library
• Design workshops with customers
• In-house compounding and tool developments
• Dedicated prototyping extrusion lines

### Small series to mass production

• Very small batches for prototyping phase
• Industrialization knowledge
• Mass production in a very stable way

### Packaging, sterilization & transport support

• Production based in France
• Worldwide supply

### RA support

• Support through FDA and MDR registrations
• First Article Inspections
• IQ, OQ, PQ validation packages

## Markets Served

Supporting innovation in minimally invasive therapies accross various medical fields.

### Cardiology

### Cardiology

THVR
AAA endoprosthesis delivery system
Coronary bifurcation stent delivery system
Diagnostic catheter
Aortic & venous cannulas for extracorporeal heart & lung support
Vascular sealant applicator
LAA closure delivery system

### Bariatrics

### Bariatrics

Endoscopic suturing system
Laparoscopic mixing device for surgical sealant
Stomach wireless implant delivery system to prevent heart failure
Implant delivery system for acid reflux disease

### Neurology

### Neurology

Neurovascular guiding catheter
Clot Retriever device for acute ischemic stroke
Neuroballoon catheter for dilation of cerebral membrane

### Cell Therapy

### Cell Therapy

Cell therapy delivery system into the cardiac muscle

[ Discover more ][24]

## Our commitments: innovating care & inspiring lives

### Customer centricity

We foster a collaborative approach and long-term partnerships.

### Quality & Standards

With over 25 years of ISO 13485 certification, we design and manufacture in full compliance with the
highest international standards.

### Responsiveness

We are an agile and reliable partner dedicated to answering your most complex needs and projects.

### Innovation

We develop custom solutions and processes that integrate the latest innovations for your products.

## Your trusted partner for innovative medical solutions compliant with international standards.

[ Learn more about our solutions ][25]

## Custom solutions for your projects

[ [Custom medical tubing capabilities including shaping and extrusion by Nexinlife.] ][26]

### Our Capabilities

Multilumen extrusion · Coextrusion · Reinforced tubing · Overmolding ·
Shaping, Tipping, Stretching,
Bending & Welding

[ [Minimally invasive catheter solution developed by Nexinlife medical devices.] ][27]

### Our Solutions

Custom development: prototypes, co-design, and industrialization · Contract manufacturing and series
production · Regulatory support and full traceability

][28]

to minimally invasive delivery systems**. We help our customers **from conception and engineering to

cardiovascular, neurology, gastroenterology and many other applications.

• Worldwide supply

## Official Website

## Philippine Society of Cardiovascular Catheterization and Interventions

### A Message From Our President

## Eric Oliver D. Sison, M.D.

A warm welcome to the PSCCI webpage. The field of interventional cardiology is fast evolving, with
new insights from trials, new devices and techniques and new guidelines for Clinical practice. On
the other hand, it is also very helpful for us to be reminded of timeless interventional principles
and techniques as well as to learn from the experience of our colleagues on how to tackle
challenging cases and clinical situations. It is in this light that a venue wherein, we as an
organization of interventional cardiologists in the country, can come together to be able to be
updated with news and findings in our field and share our own cases and participate in collegial
discussion was put up. We hope to be able to provide all members with a resource that they can use
to continually learn and also be able to share their experiences, through the webinars, lectures and
case presentations that are archived in this website. We hope to also to be able to connect and
network with members all over the country, so we can also be updated with the activities, goals and
projects of the society. May we continue to work together to advance the field of interventional
cardiology in the country.

Eric Oliver D. Sison, M.D.

## President, PSCCI Inc.

### A Message From

## Jose Jonas D. Del Rosario, MD, FPSCCI

Dear PSCCI Members

This website has been created with the objective of keeping the members informed and updated on the
various activities of our society.  It is also a platform for continuing education for our members
through recorded webinars, interesting live cases and instructional images.  It will also be a forum
where members can communicate with each other especially on various topics related to our
specialty.  Lastly, we are working on using this website as a portal to access the journal
EuroIntervention.

Welcome to the PSCCI website. This is our home. 

Jose Jonas D. Del Rosario, MD, FPSCCI

## Director, PSCCI Inc.

### [Suggested Readings][51]

### [Acute Myocardial Infarction in Very Young Filipino Adults][52]

### [An Unusual Case of Partial Anomalous Pulmonary Venous Return, Lung Sequestration, Mitral Valve
### Prolapse, and Coarctation of the Aorta in an Adult Male Filipino][53]

### [Predictors of In-Hospital Outcomes among Octogenarians with Acute ST-elevation Myocardial
### Infarction at the Philippine Heart Center][54]

### Subscribe Now

Subscribe to EuroIntervention, an international, English language, peer-reviewed journal whose aim
is to create a community of high-quality research and education in the field of percutaneous and
surgical cardiovascular interventions.
[ Click Here ][55]

## About PSCCI

PSCCI aims to advance the standards of cardiac catheterization and percutaneous interventions so as
to enhance patient care; to promote excellence in the practice of cardiovascular intervention, and;
to promote patient education on cardiac catheterization.

It has accomplished registries of different interventions and currently conducts education programs
in coordination with the Philippine Society of Cardiac Catheterization and Intervention. The Council
also is in the process of standardizing the subspecialty fellowship program in adult interventional
cardiology in the different training institutions, and modifying international guidelines on
cardiovascular intervention to suit the local setting.

## Official Website

## Philippine Society of Cardiovascular Catheterization and Interventions

### A Message From Our President

## Eric Oliver D. Sison, M.D.

A warm welcome to the PSCCI webpage. The field of interventional cardiology is fast evolving, with
new insights from trials, new devices and techniques and new guidelines for Clinical practice. On
the other hand, it is also very helpful for us to be reminded of timeless interventional principles
and techniques as well as to learn from the experience of our colleagues on how to tackle
challenging cases and clinical situations. It is in this light that a venue wherein, we as an
organization of interventional cardiologists in the country, can come together to be able to be
updated with news and findings in our field and share our own cases and participate in collegial
discussion was put up. We hope to be able to provide all members with a resource that they can use
to continually learn and also be able to share their experiences, through the webinars, lectures and
case presentations that are archived in this website. We hope to also to be able to connect and
network with members all over the country, so we can also be updated with the activities, goals and
projects of the society. May we continue to work together to advance the field of interventional
cardiology in the country.

Eric Oliver D. Sison, M.D.

## President, PSCCI Inc.

### A Message From

## Jose Jonas D. Del Rosario, MD, FPSCCI

Dear PSCCI Members

This website has been created with the objective of keeping the members informed and updated on the
various activities of our society.  It is also a platform for continuing education for our members
through recorded webinars, interesting live cases and instructional images.  It will also be a forum
where members can communicate with each other especially on various topics related to our
specialty.  Lastly, we are working on using this website as a portal to access the journal
EuroIntervention.

Welcome to the PSCCI website. This is our home. 

Jose Jonas D. Del Rosario, MD, FPSCCI

## Director, PSCCI Inc.

is to create a community of high-quality research and education in the field of percutaneous and
surgical cardiovascular interventions.

## About PSCCI

PSCCI aims to advance the standards of cardiac catheterization and percutaneous interventions so as
to enhance patient care; to promote excellence in the practice of cardiovascular intervention, and;
to promote patient education on cardiac catheterization.

It has accomplished registries of different interventions and currently conducts education programs
in coordination with the Philippine Society of Cardiac Catheterization and Intervention. The Council
also is in the process of standardizing the subspecialty fellowship program in adult interventional
cardiology in the different training institutions, and modifying international guidelines on
cardiovascular intervention to suit the local setting.

### COMPANY PROFILE

## Relisys Medical Devices Ltd.

Relisys Medical Devices Limited is one of the world’s largest manufacturer of cardiovascular medical
devices including Coronary Stent Systems – both Bare Metal Stent Systems & Drug Eluting Stent
Systems, PTCA Balloon Catheters, Angiographic Diagnostic Catheters, Guiding Catheters and
Transcatheter Heart Valves. We constantly innovate and upgrade our portfolio to offer solutions to
treat life-threatening heart diseases. Backed by strong R & D, we constantly work on process &
product innovation thereby offering better solutions to the patients at affordable prices.

utilize data from patients and devices for hypertension management, heart failure management, and
rhythm management [CIEDs, MCOTs, EKGs, etc]. Receive actionable data from implantable or external
cardiac devices for patients with hypertension, heart failure, and rhythm disorders.

Access critical cardiology data with simple workflows.

Technical services teams can supplement existing clinical care teams to provide expert patient
engagement services. Trained team members are available to help with alert management, patient

# Robot Simulation Software

RoboDK is a complete solution to simulate and program robot arms offline for robot manufacturing and
automation.

[ Download Trial ][47]

## Extensive Robot Library

Up-to-date library of robot arms, manufacturing applications and sample industrial automation
projects.

[Library][48]

## CAD/CAM Software

Extensive integration options with CAD/CAM software, making it easier to simulate and program robots
to automate manufacturing.

[Success Stories][49]

## Marketplace

Plenty of Add-ins and extensions at your disposal to enhance and customize RoboDK software.

[Add-in Marketplace][50]

## Easy to Use

RoboDK's intuitive interface requires no programming skills to simulate robot arms and the
step-by-step guide simplifies the process of generating robot programs.

[ Getting Started Guide][51]

## Software Features

RoboDK offers all the features required create your Digital Twin quickly and accurately.

[RoboDK robot]
* [
  
  ### Robot Simulation & Offline Programming
  
  Create robot simulations and robot programs for any robot arm in minutes. You can easily and
  accurately simulate your robot arms with RoboDK software.
  
  ][52]
* [
  
  ### Robot Machining
  
  Use robots for manufacturing applications such as robot machining or 3D printing. Simulate and
  convert 5-axis CNC programs such as G-Code or APT-CLS for your robot controller.
  
  ][53]
* [
  
  ### Robot Programs
  
  Easily generate robot programs offline for any robot controller. You don't need to learn
  vendor-specific programming anymore.
  
  ][54]
* [
  
  ### Support 3D Models
  
  Import 3D models in formats such as STL, STEP, and IGES, and accurately create your Digital Twin.
  
  ][55]
* [
  
  ### Post Processors
  
  RoboDK Post Processors include support for many robot controllers, including ABB RAPID (mod/prg),
  Fanuc (LS/TP), KUKA KRC (SRC), Motoman Inform (JBI), Universal Robots (URP/script) and much more!
  
  ][56]
* [
  
  ### External Axes
  
  Easily integrate and simulate robots with external axes to extend the reachability of your robot.
  
  ][57]
* [
  
  ### Robot Accuracy
  
  Calibrate your robot arm to improve accuracy up to 0.100 mm. RoboDK software combines all the
  simulation and calibration features in one solution.
  
  ][58]
* [
  
  ### Avoid Singularities and Collisions
  
  Easily create your Digital Twin offline and prevent the robot from going through singularities,
  axis limits and collisions.
  
  ][59]
* [
  
  ### RoboDK API
  
  Create robot programs using modern programming languages such as Python, C# or C++. Software
  developers can easily customize the interface.
  
  ][60]

## Supported Robot Brands

RoboDK supports over 80 different robot manufacturers, providing access to an extensive robot
library.

[ Robot Library][61]
[ 15 more ][62]

## Robot Applications

Use robot arms for any manufacturing application. You can find plenty of examples in our
documentation.

RoboDK offers all the features required create your Digital Twin quickly and accurately.

  accurately simulate your robot arms with RoboDK software.

  convert 5-axis CNC programs such as G-Code or APT-CLS for your robot controller.
  
  ][53]
* [
  
  ### Robot Programs
  
  Easily generate robot programs offline for any robot controller. You don't need to learn
  vendor-specific programming anymore.
  
  ][54]

  Import 3D models in formats such as STL, STEP, and IGES, and accurately create your Digital Twin.
  
  ][55]

  RoboDK Post Processors include support for many robot controllers, including ABB RAPID (mod/prg),
  Fanuc (LS/TP), KUKA KRC (SRC), Motoman Inform (JBI), Universal Robots (URP/script) and much more!
  
  ][56]
* [
  
  ### External Axes
  
  Easily integrate and simulate robots with external axes to extend the reachability of your robot.
  
  ][57]
* [
  
  ### Robot Accuracy
  
  Calibrate your robot arm to improve accuracy up to 0.100 mm. RoboDK software combines all the
  simulation and calibration features in one solution.
  
  ][58]
* [
  
  ### Avoid Singularities and Collisions
  
  Easily create your Digital Twin offline and prevent the robot from going through singularities,
  axis limits and collisions.
  
  ][59]

  ### RoboDK API
  
  Create robot programs using modern programming languages such as Python, C# or C++. Software
  developers can easily customize the interface.
  
  ][60]

# Why Choose Vijaya Diagnostic Centre?

It begins with a question—a doubt, a discomfort, a concern that brings you searching for clarity. At
that moment, when health feels uncertain, what one needs most is reassurance—the quiet confidence
that someone will handle your concern with care, the certainty that the answers you seek will come
with both precision and thoughtfulness.

## Built on Trust, Backed by Expertise

Since our inception in 1981, we have remained true to one simple promise—diagnostics with a human
touch. From a modest beginning, we have grown into one of India’s most respected diagnostic
networks. We have achieved this feat by providing top-quality diagnostic care and earning the trust
of numerous customers across the country.

Our team today is made up of over 3000 dedicated professionals, including 300+ of India’s leading
specialised and super-specialised radiologists and pathologists. Along with their deep expertise and
technical skills, they bring empathy, compassion, and a strong commitment to patient care.

Every test we conduct is handled with precision and responsibility—because we understand that your
medical reports aren’t just numbers, they’re the foundation of your peace of mind.

We also offer a wide range of [health packages][139] curated for every age group and lifestyle,
ensuring preventive care is accessible and personalised. Understanding that healthcare is not just
about treatment but also about prevention, we have curated a comprehensive suite of preventive
health check-up packages tailored to diverse age groups, health conditions, and lifestyles.

## Accessible Care, Thoughtfully Delivered

Today, Vijaya is present in 6 states, across 25 cities with over [160 centres][140]. Each one of
these centres carries the same hallmark of care. Our centres are spread over multiple locations
across 25+ cities, which means there’s a Vijaya diagnostic centre near you whenever you want
effective diagnostic care. No matter which centre you visit, our philosophy remains unchanged:
offering patients consistent quality, accessible service, and unwavering integrity.

For those who cannot come to us because of health issues, age, or tight schedules, we come to them.
Our [home sample collection][141] service is not just a convenience—it’s a commitment to ensuring
that no one is left behind and care reaches the doorstep of those who need it the most.

## A Quiet Presence in Life’s Important Moments

Every day, people walk into our centres with concerns they may not always say out loud. Some come
alone; some are accompanied by loved ones. Some are looking for answers. Others simply want
reassurance. And in these quiet, crucial moments, we stand beside them, not just as professionals,
but as trusted partners in their journey towards better health.

## Numbers That Speak of Trust, Not Just Growth

Over the last 40+ years, Vijaya has quietly built a legacy rooted in both care and credibility. Our
strength lies in our people—3000+ skilled professionals, including 300+ specialised and super
specialised radiologists and pathologists who bring experience and empathy to their work. We’ve had
the privilege of serving 100+ million individuals, and we are trusted by 450+ organisations across
the country.

## Uncompromising on Quality and Accreditation

Quality is at the heart of Vijaya Diagnostic Centre’s operations—it’s a culture that’s ingrained in
our practices and deep-rooted in our professional approaches. Every process is governed by globally
recognised standards, ensuring your health is always the top priority. Our diagnostic laboratories
are accredited by NABL, our flagship centre is certified under ISO 9001:2015, and our operations
align with NABH protocols to ensure clinical excellence and patient safety.

## Because You Deserve Nothing Less

When you choose Vijaya Diagnostic Centre, you are choosing care that is personal, not transactional.
You are choosing an experience grounded in science and service rooted in empathy. You are choosing a
place where every step—from booking a diagnostic test to reporting—is designed around your comfort.

At every [diagnostic centre][142] under our network, the focus remains the same: accurate diagnosis,
timely reporting, seamless experience, and compassionate communication.

Most importantly, you are choosing a team that understands that behind every test lies a person—a
life, a story, and a hope. And that’s a responsibility we carry with pride.

## Trust Vijaya for Advanced Medical Care

Whether you are looking for a [radiology centre][143] or pathology tests, Vijaya Diagnostic Centre
is the first and ultimate choice. Our vision and reputation have made us the leading name in the
medical sector.

As one of the best [diagnostic centres][144], Vijaya offers world-class support and advanced care,
which can help clinicians diagnose the exact medical issue you are experiencing.

Get in touch with us for the best diagnostic support delivered with professionalism, care, and
empathy.

For any enquiries or more information, Call Us Today!
